proposal: Antipodal View cancellation audit before adding branches
necessary_condition: invertible Q and -Q equally weighted under stated activation

proposal: Precomposition legality boundary for nonlinear expert codes

proposal: Value-only Views sharing one score map and one attention aggregation
necessary_condition: identical p for all Views and transforms constant over source tokens
strong_control: SwitchHead-style projection experts plus explicit materialization
decision_gate: exactness then full model quality and kernel benchmark

necessary_condition: exact groups must share p; approximate groups need explicit error budget
strong_control: separate maps for every active View
first_test: interpolate same-logit and different-logit teacher families
decision_gate: no quality claim without downstream output and NLL tolerance

necessary_condition: common hidden state and paid residual basis

proposal: Batch transformed queries across shared-prefix branches with exact LSE merge

proposal: Separate K and V sharing/residual budgets across layers

first_test: fork; mutate suffix; verify sibling prefix/read outputs
